messages:
jules: FYI - Valence Capital POC hit two enterprise blockers: 1) SAML cert rotation process (they want zero-downtime), 2) procurement wants a one-paragraph estimate of any incremental cost for SCIM at 20k users during the 60-day pilot.

arjun: For cert rotation we support dual-certs on the SAML integration: upload new cert + enable staged key, then toggle primary. We do a sanity check on metadata and keep old cert active for 72h to allow IdP propagation. Minimal downtime if they follow steps.

marie: Can you paste the exact flow we recommend? They asked for CLI steps they can hand to their IdP team.

arjun: Sure - high level: 1) Upload new cert in UI/POST to /v1/saml/metadata with new cert metadata; 2) Mark new cert as secondary; 3) Wait for IdP to push new signing key (we keep old for 72h); 4) Promote new cert to primary; 5) Remove old cert when verified. Example curl to upload: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -F "metadata=@valence-new.xml" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/saml/metadata`

security: Note: for Private installs we require the metadata upload through the on-prem control-plane UI by default. API upload needs the management role. Also recommend they enable assertion signature verification and set audience to `https://api.redwood.ai/saml/valence-9876`.

jules: Procurement pricing ask: what's the delta for control-plane (SCIM) ops at 20k users, daily incremental syncs (approx 10% churn/day), and webhook audit export to their SIEM (with HMAC). They want ballpark for their budget doc.

pricing: Quick ballpark: SCIM calls are control-plane and included in Hosted standard for pilots; no per-token billing. For 20k users with 2k changes/day expect ~2k PATCH/POST ops + 20k GETs if they run full nightly sync; recommend incremental sync to cut that. Network egress and their IdP costs are usually the main billable items. Enabling audit export and 12mo retention is an enterprise add-on (~$3k/mo typical) — put as estimate not final.

marie: Can we give them a recommended rate-limit config and batching tip to keep syncs smooth?

arjun: Yes - recommend SCIM batching of 500, concurrency 4, and retry backoff 2s. For full syncs, use pagination and delta tokens; avoid parallel full scans to reduce load.

jules: They also asked: will role mappings support attribute-based mapping (e.g., `department==finance` -> billing_view)?

security: We support attribute rules in mapping: you can match on SAML attributes or SCIM group membership. Example rule: `if attribute.department == "Finance" then grant role billing_view`. Audit events include matched attributes if allowed by privacy policy.

infra-bot: POC workspace `valence-poc-9876` created with expiry 2026-01-09T00:00:00Z. Invite: https://console.redwood.ai/p/valence-poc-9876/invite

jules: Great. I'll send the cert rotation steps, the pricing note, and the workspace link. If procurement wants a formal quote I'll loop in sales_ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:
